title: Why 80% of Americans Are Not Saving Enough

scenes.fact: In 2023, roughly 80% of US adults are struggling to save money.
scenes.text: 80% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck.
Only 39% of Americans can cover a $1,000 emergency expense.
